notes.title: 🎮 YES: We're Controller-Ready!! Play Stellar Destiny: The Last Survivor NOW
notes.notes:
[p][b]Xbox, PlayStation – and most third-party controllers? Yep, probably even yours![/b][/p][p][/p][p]🔥 Stellar Destiny: The Last Survivor now comes with [b]full controller support[/b]!
The game automatically detects any controller input – the moment you touch it, the system instantly switches to full controller layout with responsive UI, button prompts, and full feature support.
True plug-and-play experience.[/p][p][/p][h3]Now it’s getting interesting:[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Smoother directional movement[/p][/*][*][p]Vibration feedback on hits – feel every impact[/p][/*][*][p]Native support for Xbox and PlayStation controllers[/p][/*][*][p]Compatibility with most third-party controllers[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic switching between input methods[/p][/*][*][p]In-game UI updates on the fly to reflect the controller you're holding[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665697/9b9dbced03d5d9c7cc4aed6e08507478e56298b4.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]🔜 Nope, that’s not all…[/h3][p]

notes.title: 💥 BOOM! 100+ players already have it on their wishlist!
notes.notes:
[p]🙏 Thanks a ton! We’ve just passed 100 wishlists! That was fast 🚀 and it’s a clear sign that [b]Stellar Destiny: The Last Survivor is already cooking.[/b] Big thanks to everyone who already added us and if you’re still thinking about it... time’s ticking 😉[/p][p]And don’t worry, we’re not slacking off. We’re going full throttle: tuning controls, boosting visual effects, balancing gameplay, squashing bugs, and building fresh content! Every day gets us closer to a truly explosive version.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Improving the feel of the game[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Even in the current demo, you’ll feel the difference: tighter gameplay and better combat feedback. We’ve added [b]hit highlighting based on damage type[/b], plus [b]new impact effects when you take a hit[/b]. Visual feedback on both your character and the screen just got way sharper.
And when your HP drops low? You’ll know. Trust us — the new warning effects hit different.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665697/200cdbaccfa8c3dd0387d3249e32cb89f8f74880.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Strategic movement with your [b]mining drone[/b] now matters more than ever — stray too far and you’ll lose the signal.
We’ve also added [b]visual effects for terrain scanning and resource mining[/b] to bring more atmosphere and replay value to every run.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665697/8d0547acc6a1ea66e8707c4f24f7c3ef2c82cdc3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We’ve tightened enemy damage cones, sped up animations, and reworked abilities like Whirlwind and Mini Rockets.
Behind the scenes, a ton of graphical and performance tweaks are live — from reduced draw distance and optimized terrain to compressed enemy models, improved textures, and visual polish like weather and environmental upgrades.[/p][p][/p][p]And this is just the beginning.
Wanna be there when the dark galaxies fully awaken?[/p][p]👉 [b]Add the game to your wishlist. Don’t miss a thing.[/b][/p][p]🎮 Find more info, updates, and the community right here on Steam — and join us on Discord to hang out and chat![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/azqyUVhZgy" style="button"]Join our Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for supporting us! Thanks for playing,  [/p][p][b]Your dev team[/b] | [i]Stellar Destiny: The Last Survivor[/i][/p]

notes.title: DEMO IS OUT 🔥👉 you need to play this! 🔥
notes.notes:
[p][b]No more warm-up: the first public demo of [i]Stellar Destiny: The Last Survivor[/i] has landed.[/b][/p][p]The galaxy won’t wait for you, and it sure as hell won’t root for you. Every run trips you up in a different way. One bad call, one messed-up mix and you’re done. Restart. Again. And again.[/p][p][b]The real question: how long will you last?[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665697/df5fd9c54af1dc9290b2a97868e877636587577d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Why you’ll get hooked:[/h3][p][/p][p]🔥 [b]Combat unchained[/b] – slash, dodge, drone strike. No breaks, no mercy.
🧪 [b]Crazy compounds[/b] – mix chemicals that flip your abilities and style.
🌍 [b]Worlds that hate you[/b] – procedurally generated deathtraps, every run different.
🤖 [b]AI whispers[/b] – fragments and whispers that won’t let you sleep.[/p][p][/p][h3]Your move:[/h3][p]👉 [b]Grab the demo[/b] – see how far you can push before it breaks you.[/p][p]👉 [b]Wishlist the full game[/b] – help us hack the algorithm.[/p][p]👉 [b]Join Discord[/b] – drop feedback, or just memes, whatever.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665697/30a7c474725c9470514e5d7b9108ab60b94320e9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This isn’t a “sneak peek.”
This is your [b]first drop into a galaxy that wants you dead[/b].
And when you fall? Restart. Again. And again. And again.[/p][p]We’re waiting for you.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/azqyUVhZgy" style="button"]Join our Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing, 
[b]Your dev team[/b] | [i]Stellar Destiny: The Last Survivor[/i][/p]

notes.title: PLAYTEST 0.2 – Ranked abilities, sharper style, deeper cuts
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey! Time to jump back into action. Our first major update is here[/h3][p]
And we’ve turned up the heat. Playtest 0.2 brings key improvements that give you more options, better combat feel, and some serious visual upgrades.[/p][p][/p][h3]Ability Rank System[/h3][p]Not all elements are created equal — and not every mining run makes you a god.
Find out which ones are worth the grind and watch your power grow.
Loot planets, stack effects, and build something that [i]actually[/i] shreds.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665697/edb05ab7ba5d3812dc5f553ec0f183f69f6dd82e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]New Ship Visuals[/h3][p]Your base just got a glow-up.
New atmosphere, new details, a fresh coat of cosmic paint — come check out the latest in intergalactic interior design 😎[/p][p][/p][h3]Updated Level Visuals[/h3][p]The world looks better than ever — more depth, more mood, more “oh no, this place is definitely hostile.”
Refreshed lighting and reworked environments are live.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665697/d3c0115409eccca5d425bccccce33c2d2e34d92d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Core Combat Stays – Fast, Fluid, and Tactical[/h3][p]The heart of the game is still there: fast-paced battles, responsive dodging, smart combos.
Slice through enemies, mine elements, craft compounds, and tweak your build to stay alive. Or not.
Boot it up and see how far you get.[/p][p][/p][h3]💬 Tell Us What Hits and What Misses[/h3][p]This update was shaped by your feedback — thanks! And keep it coming. Join our Discord and let us know what hits, what needs love, and what made you yell “yo, that was sick.” 👉 [url="https://discord.gg/azqyUVhZgy"]Join our Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]⭐ Wishlist = Fuel for the Journey[/h3][p]Excited for what’s next? Add the game to your wishlist and stay locked in for more updates.
It also helps us blast through the Steam algorithm galaxy.

notes.title: PLAYTEST 0.1 – Slash, survive, welcome to the void
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey there – this is not the one to skip.[/h3][p]
The first public playtest of Stellar Destiny: The Last Survivor is live — and you’re not here to stargaze. Dive headfirst into [b]the massacre of unknown alien worlds[/b], feel [b]THAT combat rush[/b], meet your first enemies, your ship, and most of all, unleash the raw, unconventional abilities of your player and drone.
[/p][p]Time to slice monsters, test your skills, and build your AI into the deadliest machine in the system.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665697/0b897ce741b2a05231864809b421a57fa58dcc24.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Meet the Ship. And Your Enemies.[/h3][p][/p][p]Welcome aboard your [b]damaged spaceship[/b].
Your AI just booted up — and its first move, in the form of [b]SYNR (Synthetic Runner)[/b], is heading straight toward a planet swarming with merciless enemies.
Get a taste of [b]hostile lifeforms[/b] that won't care who you are, just how fast you die. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665697/38f0d94822873a9de5eeee96447135b8967e4fd9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Combat in the Void – try Playtest 0.1, and you’ll be eagerly waiting for the next update.[/h3][p][/p][p]Test fast, twitchy combat full of [b]dodging, slicing, and raw precision[/b].
Mix high-impact melee with devastating drone strikes, and experiment with your [b]first build paths[/b].
Explore your first [b]unforgiving planets[/b], soak in the atmosphere, and feel how core movement and combat mechanics come together.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]We want to hear from you![/h3][p][/p][p][b]What did you think of your first drop? Not bad, huh? [/b]Got thoughts on combat tempo, the feel of movement, or how the drone handles?
Your feedback moves us forward, so 👉 [url="https://discord.gg/azqyUVhZgy"]join our Discord[/url] and drop us a message about what hit just right. [b]We're there. [/b]And yes, we’re reading it.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Wishlist = your weapon against forgetfulness[/h3][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy the game as much as we love making it. If you don’t want to miss what’s coming next — stay tuned and don’t forget to [b]add Stellar Destiny to your wishlist on Steam[/b] to stay locked in.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing,
[b]Your dev team[/b] | [i]Stellar Destiny: The Last Survivor[/i][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/azqyUVhZgy" style="button"]Join our Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665697/2845c8363e0bb1f9a69f1ab2812f20f063177d2b.png"][/img][/p]
